# Responsive UI Design

Test conceptually at phone, tablet, laptop, desktop, and large desktop widths.

- Avoid fixed widths that cause overflow.
- Use fluid sizing with sensible max-widths.
- Keep touch targets usable.
- Collapse navigation intentionally.
- Make tables responsive without hiding critical information.
- Preserve form usability on small screens.
- Prevent horizontal scrolling unless the content genuinely requires it.
